name.text: CHEM_U03_L02_GP Q01 - Ionic Bonding and Formula Units

questiontext.text:
MLA Standard: MLA.CHEM.BON.01; MLA.CHEM.BON.02

Stimulus:

IonsCharge balanceFormula unit
Ca2+ and Cl-+2 balances two -1 ionsCaCl2
Al3+ and O2-two +3 ions balance three -2 ionsAl2O3

Question: Which statement connects the model to the chemistry standard?

generalfeedback.text: Use the embedded stimulus first, then connect the evidence to the bonding, formula, property, or nomenclature rule.

answer.text: CaCl2 is neutral because calcium changes its charge from 2+ to 1+.

feedback.text: This choice does not correctly use ion charges or the formula-unit ratio shown in the stimulus.

answer.text: Subscripts are chosen to make the compound name sound correct.

answer.text: Al2O3 is neutral because 2 plus 3 equals 5.

feedback.text: This choice does not correctly use ion charges or the formula-unit ratio shown in the stimulus.

answer.text: Subscripts in ionic formulas show ion ratios, not separate molecules.

feedback.text: The stimulus shows that ionic formulas are built by balancing total positive and negative charge in the smallest ratio.
